description: Report only: from the import, export and part directives of tracked Dart files, how many lib libraries each test's import closure reaches on average, the most-reached libraries, per-file reach (--reach), the effect of cutting named edges (--cut from:to) and chokepoints (--chokepoints: barrels, widely imported files and hubs ranked by the reach removed if every edge into them is cut). Re-measures the test blast radius after each import-graph cut; it approximates, and does not replace, the Flutter test selector.
